intro: ADHD Compass 將每日計畫、專注計時、用藥紀錄與就診筆記放在同一個地方。把待辦拆成小步驟並設定提醒，開始、暫停或繼續專注計時，再按日期回顧自己填寫的心情、睡眠與用藥紀錄。
照護不同的人時，可分開保存觀察與預約，記下就診問題和後續事項。紀錄保存在裝置上，不需建立帳號，並可匯出或還原資料。
Compass Pro 提供可命名的計時設定、可重用流程、首頁排列與自評趨勢比較。另有橫跨 5 個人生階段的 10 個 ADHD 虛構生活情境，可選一個做法、閱讀後續，再換個選項比較；故事、選項與後續都有完整十語系，閱讀進度保存在裝置上。故事不能用來診斷 ADHD，也不能預測任何人的人生。
features: 任務與今日總覽
將待辦拆成小步驟並設定提醒，整理當天的任務、身心狀態與接下來的行程。
專注計時
選擇專注或休息時長，開始、暫停或繼續計時；Pro 可保存命名計時設定及重用流程。
用藥與每日紀錄
記下用藥與日常狀況，回顧自己填寫的觀察；紀錄不能用來判定藥物療效。
分開保存照護資料
為不同受照顧者保存各自的觀察、預約、就診問題與後續事項。
本機資料與備份
無須帳號，紀錄留在裝置；可匯出 JSON 或 CSV，並以 JSON 備份還原。
官方參考資料
依主題查閱 ADHD 官方教育資源，附九種語言的 ASRS v1.1 成人篩檢官方 PDF；此版本未開放 App 內問卷作答。
虛構生活情境（Pro）
閱讀橫跨 5 個人生階段的 10 個情境，選擇做法並比較後續。故事、選項與後續支援十種語言，進度留在裝置，已選項目清楚標示。
stepDetails: 從今日總覽新增任務，拆成較小的步驟並視需要設定提醒。到專注計時器選擇時長後開始，可暫停、繼續或安排休息，逐步處理眼前的事情。
記下用藥及每日狀況，再依日期或時間範圍回顧紀錄。照護多人時，將每位受照顧者的觀察分開保存；這些自我回報不等於診斷，也不能判斷藥物療效。
將預約、就診問題與後續事項整理在一起，方便回顧。到個人設定匯出 JSON 備份，日後需要時還原；匯出檔案可能包含健康或他人資訊，請妥善保管。
more: 使用最近 7 天、最近 30 天或自選日期查看紀錄，觀察日常變化；Pro 另提供自評趨勢比較，不能用來判定診斷或藥物療效。
替計時設定命名並保存，重用適合自己的流程，也可調整首頁排列。
App 資料不納入系統備份；刪除 App 或更換裝置前，先匯出並保留所需的 JSON 備份。
1.1.0 重新設計 Logo、卡片與按鈕，加深說明文字，並調整大字模式與 iPad 版面，讓內容更清楚。
tips: App 提供任務與個人紀錄工具，不提供診斷、治療或藥物劑量建議；相關問題請向合格醫療人員詢問。
官方 ASRS v1.1 成人篩檢 PDF 可供參考；篩檢不能取代診斷，此版本未開放 App 內問卷作答。
記錄他人資料前應取得適當同意，只保存需要的內容。
介面支援十種語言。Pro 為選用訂閱，取消或管理方案請使用 Apple 訂閱設定。
Pro 生活情境都是虛構故事；不同選項只是故事中的發展，不能用來診斷 ADHD 或預測任何人的人生。

intro: ADHD Compass brings daily planning, focus timers, medication records and appointment notes into one place. Break tasks into smaller steps and set reminders, start, pause or resume a focus timer, then review your own mood, sleep and medication entries by date.

Keep separate observations and appointments for each care recipient, including visit questions and follow-up actions. Records stay on your device without an account, with options to export and restore your data.

Compass Pro adds saved, named timers, reusable routines, a customizable home screen and comparisons of self-ratings. It also includes ten fictional ADHD life scenarios across five life stages: choose a response, read what happens next and compare another choice. Stories, choices and outcomes are available in ten languages, with reading progress saved locally. These stories do not diagnose ADHD or predict anyone’s life.
features: Tasks and daily overview
Break tasks into smaller steps and set reminders, then organise the day’s priorities, wellbeing entries and upcoming appointments.
Focus timers
Choose a focus or break duration, then start, pause or resume the timer. Pro adds saved, named timer settings and reusable routines.
Medication and daily records
Record medication and daily notes, then revisit your own observations. These records cannot establish medication effectiveness.
Separate care records
Keep observations, appointments, visit questions and follow-up actions separately for each care recipient.
Local data and backups
No account is required. Records stay on the device; export JSON or CSV and restore a JSON backup.
Official references
Browse official ADHD educational resources by topic and official ASRS v1.1 adult screening PDFs in nine languages. In-app questionnaire answering is not available in this release.
Fictional life scenarios (Pro)

Explore ten scenarios across five life stages, choose responses and compare outcomes. Stories, choices and outcomes support ten languages, with progress saved on your device and clear selection states.
stepDetails: Add a task from the daily overview, break it into smaller steps and set a reminder if useful. Choose a duration in the focus timer and begin; pause, resume or plan a break as you work through the task.

Record medication and daily notes, then review entries by date or time range. Keep observations separate for each care recipient. These self-reported observations are not a diagnosis and cannot determine medication effectiveness.

Keep appointments, visit questions and follow-up actions together for later review. Export a JSON backup from Profile so you can restore it when needed. Exported files may contain health information or other people’s details; keep them private.
more: View records for the last 7 days, last 30 days or selected dates to review daily changes. Pro adds comparisons of self-ratings, which cannot establish a diagnosis or medication effectiveness.
Name and save timer settings, reuse routines that suit you and customize the home screen.
App data is excluded from system backups. Export and keep the JSON backup you need before deleting the app or changing devices.
Version 1.1.0 introduces a new logo, refined cards and buttons, more readable supporting text and improved layouts for larger text and iPad.
tips: The app is a task and personal-record tool, not a source of diagnosis, treatment or medication-dose advice. Discuss these questions with a qualified healthcare professional.
Official ASRS v1.1 adult screening PDFs are available for reference. Screening is not a diagnosis, and in-app questionnaire answering is not available in this release.
Obtain appropriate consent before recording another person’s information and keep only what you need.
The interface supports ten languages. Pro is an optional subscription; use Apple subscription settings to manage or cancel it.
Pro life scenarios are fictional stories. Different choices only show developments within a story; they do not diagnose ADHD or predict anyone’s life.
